column6: With the success of The Slim Shady LP, Eminem had to make another album. Originally titled "Amsterdamn", which was one of his favorite cities, this and a combination of being "irked" by Dutch journalists (which he'd write several songs about on his first trip) and the legal drugs it had to offer is what inspired the original title. The name would go from "Amsterdamn" to "The Marshall Mathers LP" after he made the song "Marshall Mathers". This is widley considered to be one of, if not, Eminem's best album, The Marshall Mathers LP sold 1.78 million copies in its first week, which made it one of the fastest-selling studio albums in the United States.

Ca$his was the one who gave Eminem that album title, and Eminem gave Ca$his the album title "Loose Cannon". On December 24th, 2007, Eminem overdosed and nearly died. His publicist would later say it was pneumonia, which was then debunked later on. Eminem would also reconcile with Royce too, thanks to Ca$his. On April 20th, 2008, Eminem would become sober.

column6: In late 2010, Eminem & Royce would start work on Hell: The Sequel. The album name comes from a song they made in 1999 named "Bad Meets Evil" where Eminem raps at the end "see you in hell for the sequel". Em & Royce had a falling out later on and wouldn't reconcile until mid-2008 with the help of Ca$his. During the recording sessions for this album, Koolo had got his hands on some of the songs as they were being made, and decided to leak demos for the songs "Echo" and "Living Proof" in November 2010. This caused those tracks to be pushed to the deluxe edition, and a song called "Take From Me" was made about the leaks. Royce was beefing with Koolo on Twitter during this time, so Koolo would also leak a snippet for the song "Take From Me", as a way to get back at Royce for "disrespecting his mother".

column7: Following a hiatus after the release of Music To Be Murdered By: Side B, Eminem began teasing a new album in early 2024. A teaser for the album released on April 26th, 2024 that featured a fake news report about the murder of Slim Shady. Following the single release of 'Houdini' and another album trailer with a callback to Popsomp Hills from the Relapse era, The Death Of Slim Shady (Coupe de Grace) released on July 12th, 2024.
